subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check

Alex / Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and next steps from my side:

- What we heard: Acme is validating a contextual search + summarization flow for your internal knowledge base and a small customer support assistant. Goal is to measure latency and unit cost under typical daily volume.
- Pilot scope: 4 weeks (evaluation + functional validation), initial model variants: redwood-3-small for embeddings + redwood-3-medium for chat.

To help us size the pilot and confirm whether we can extend credits, could you confirm two quick items:
1) Estimated token volume (per day or week) for the pilot (prompts + outputs + embeddings). If you only have API call counts that’s fine — we can translate.
2) Target unit economics / budget range for production — e.g., target $/1M tokens or top-line monthly budget.

If you’re looking for an additional credit allocation while you run the pilot, share an estimated burn rate and a target success criteria (e.g., accuracy/latency thresholds, number of queries/day). I can loop in our capacity and finance teams for a short approval path.

Next steps: if you send the numbers today I’ll follow up with an internal request for a credits extension and a proposed terms doc.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: pilot_usage_snapshot.csv (will provide internal snapshot upon approval)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Quick answers below — happy to jump on another short call if helpful.

1) Estimated volume: currently our team expects ~3k user queries/day for the support assistant and ~1k embeddings requests/day for batch indexing. Roughly translating to tokens we’re expecting ~6–8M tokens/week (prompts + completions) and ~2–3M embedding tokens/week. Total ~8–11M tokens/week. This is early, growth could push toward ~15–20M tokens/week if the initial tests look good.

2) Budget / unit economics: the team is aiming to keep costs under $45/1M tokens for the inference portion — embeddings budget is separate but small for the pilot. Overall monthly trial budget before an executive sign-off is ~$8k–$12k.

Pilot burn so far (first 5 days): ~1.2M tokens consumed — most of that from a small test cohort. We may need extra credits if we scale the test to the full support team. Would you be able to extend an additional 2M tokens of trial credit?

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Johnson | Senior PM, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 212-555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check

Vivek / Monica —

Looping you both in on Acme (ACME-1234). They gave a nice recap and asked for a 2M token pilot credit extension. Key points:
- Current / expected burn: ~1.2M tokens used in first 5 days; estimating 8–11M tokens/week with potential to hit 15–20M if they scale.
- Target unit economics: ~ $45 / 1M tokens for inference.
- Pilot length: 4 weeks; team budget $8k–$12k/month.

Request: can we approve up to 2M tokens in free pilot credits for them to scale their test? If not full 2M, what’s the right amount and any guardrails (expiration, usage caps, required check-in cadence)? I attached the usage snapshot they provided (pilot_usage_snapshot.csv) for context.

If we approve, I’ll send them the standard pilot credit terms and set a weekly check-in with the AE + CSM.

— Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check

Marissa / Monica —

Thanks for the context. Approved to offer Acme a 1.5M token pilot credit extension with the following conditions:
- Credits expire in 30 days from issuance.
- We require weekly check-ins (AE + CSM) and a brief usage snapshot on Fridays.
- If usage accelerates above 15M tokens/week we should review routing/quota and consider a discounted committed pilot rate.

Also attached our pilot credit terms PDF for signature (redwood_pilot_credit_terms.pdf). Please include the HubSpot deal ID (ACME-1234) in the signature/DocuSign so finance can reconcile.

Vivek
VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check

Alex / Sarah —

Good news — we can extend 1.5M tokens of pilot credit to Acme. Terms (short):
- 1.5M token credit issued, expires 30 days from issuance.
- Weekly check-in (Fridays) and brief snapshot to confirm burn and success metrics.
- If burn goes above ~15M tokens/week we’ll open a pricing review and may propose a committed pilot pricing model.

I attached the pilot credit terms PDF. Please review and sign the DocuSign (link below) so finance can apply the credit. Once signed I’ll enable the credit and confirm the credit id in the pilot dashboard (link included).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/ACME-1234-pilot
Pilot dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/accounts/ACME-1234/pilot

If you want to increase the credit amount after you see the usage snapshot on Friday, let me know and we can re-evaluate. Looking forward to the next check-in.

Best —
Marissa
Attachment: redwood_pilot_credit_terms.pdf
